details: Pressing test takes a couple secs and reports “sucess!”, but nothing happens. After uninstalling the app, the original screensaver no longer triggers. Any ideas?

The 4k 240FPS (HEVC) format does not play, as its label warns.  The TEST button did not work at first. I turned on Autostart, then pressed TEST: LG's stock screensaver started, and the result said "Success!". Autostart acts only at the next boot, and I had not pressed "Apply until reboot". Before Apply, `getAppInfo` for `com.webos.app.screensaver` still reported `"type":"flutter"`, so the app can detect this case. After Apply, TEST started Aerial.  A UI suggestion: show a warning on TEST when Aerial is not applied, or apply at once when Autostart is turned on.
